'''Bargos''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] weapons officer aboard the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] warship [[Ocean (starship)|''Ocean'']],<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> during the [[Second Galactic Civil War|war]] between the Galactic Alliance and the [[Confederation]]. He was ordered to fire a torpedo into empty space to confirm whether [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] had seen a hidden fleet arrive into the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]] as he previously reported. In fact, it had been a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] illusion used by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] against Solo helping to further place doubt in the minds of officers in Solo's competence.
